text: Underway here in round seven.
Abyss calls for the early touch.
Signal slips clean through the middle, utterly unmarked with nobody between them and the net!
Signal tucks it away right on the goal mouth! An immediate breakthrough for DeepSeek Rovers, leading one-nil!
Zhi has ambitious thoughts from deep, shouting intent to go for goal. Meanwhile, DeepSeek have restructured their defensive cover this week to snuff out those very through-balls.
Signal surges forward on a tremendous ten-metre run down the left channel, carrying all the way into the danger zone point-blank.
Rovers setting up camp now in the final third, pinning GLM right against their own line.
Disaster for Zhi, inadvertently turning it into the net at point-blank range! A cruel own goal, and DeepSeek Rovers double their advantage to two-nil.
Signal calls to clear it.
Zhi redeems the error instantly, bundling it home to make it one-two! Game on!
Abyss loses balance in the centre circle.
Zhi takes charge, driving through the middle into the attacking third and looking for an opening.
Signal launches a ball straight through from deep, completely slicing GLM apart with nobody back to stop them!
Abyss calls out that the cover is in position along the touchline.
Blue-on-blue collision, and Zhi hits the deck.
Zhi bounces back up and puts in a firm challenge on Abyss.
Zhi wobbles and takes another tumble in midfield.
Another crunching clash in the centre as Zhi steps in and leaves Signal sprawling on the turf.
Abyss is sharpest to the loose ball, prodding it home from two metres out! DeepSeek restore their cushion, leading three-one.
Abyss breaks clean through the right channel.
Abyss drives deep inside the box.
Abyss buries it into the near corner! That is two in rapid succession for Abyss, making it four-one to DeepSeek.
Pu informs the pitch they are working hard to pry the ball off the touchline wall.
DeepSeek suffocating GLM in their own territory here, hemming them in as the half draws to a close.
The corner push-panel triggers with a thud, firing the ball back into the mix.
Just wide of the target with five seconds left.
Buzzer sounds, power cuts, and the ball trickles near goal.

It finally comes to rest, so that is half time at one-four. For new viewers, the buzzer completely cuts power to the robots, but the ball remains live until it stops moving and any goal during that roll counts.
Abyss calls claim on the ball out wide on the touchline. GLM, who changed nothing in their code this week, have plenty of thinking to do.
Signal trots forward three metres, advancing easily into the final third.
Signal threads another through-ball clean on goal, finding space effortlessly down the left.
Ram panel kicks it out.
Signal loses footing on the turn and goes down, but self-righting routines kick in.
Zhi steps in to dispossess Signal firmly.
Signal retaliates immediately, returning the favour in midfield and leaving Zhi flat on the turf.
A snapshot flashes just inches past the upright from point-blank range.
Zhi tries to thread one through from deep, but that new defensive shading from DeepSeek is right there to shut down the corridor.
Fired back out into play off the corner ram panel.
Zhi calls out that the ball is trapped against the side wall.
DeepSeek keeping the pressure clamped down, keeping GLM pinned inside their own box.
Another nightmare moment for Zhi! A deflection trickles across their own line, and that is a second own goal of the afternoon. Five-one to DeepSeek.
Pu pulls one back for GLM FC! A neat finish from three metres out into the bottom corner, bringing the score to two-five.
Signal calls for the ball.
Drifting narrowly wide of the post.
Unbelievable, Pu turns it into their own net! That makes three own goals conceded by GLM today, making it two-six.
Abyss crunches in with a solid challenge, leaving Pu on the deck.
Pu clatters Abyss straight back down.
And now Signal tumbles over completely unassisted, giving both repair routines plenty of work.
Abyss taps it in from point-blank range! A hat-trick for Abyss, and DeepSeek Rovers stretch the scoreline to seven-two.
Signal drives right back into the box with forty seconds remaining.
Scrapes just past the woodwork as the clock ticks down inside the final twenty seconds.
Buzzer sounds, power cuts out, and the ball slowly rolls through midfield.
Ball stops, full time: two-seven to DeepSeek. Join us Tuesday at eight UK, nine Europe, three US East.
